name: Medusa Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-hosted open-source commerce framework and admin dashboard for products, carts, orders, payments and custom storefronts; core MIT-licensed software has no subscription or GMV platform fee.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires separately paid or operated compute, PostgreSQL, storage and maintenance; third-party integrations and payment processing may incur fees. Enterprise RBAC/SSO features are not MIT-licensed. Medusa Cloud hosting is paid from $29/month and is not a free hosted tier.
